level_one.title: Mana Addict
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

level_four.title: Nether Wind
level_four.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

level_seven.title: Burned Flesh
level_seven.description: When Flamestrike damages 2 or more Heroes, they take additional damage equal to 8% of their maximum Health.

level_ten.title: Pyroblast
level_ten.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

level_thirteen.title: Pyromaniac
level_thirteen.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Fury of the Sunwell
level_sixteen.description: Flamestrike will explode a second time 1.5 seconds later.

level_twenty.title: Flamethrower
level_twenty.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Tough As Nails
level_one.description: Every 16 seconds, gain 60 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 60%.  Stores up to 3 charges. Charges refresh 200% faster while Fury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

level_four.title: Shot Of Fury
level_four.description: Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding.  Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.

level_seven.title: Battle Rage
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.  Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

level_ten.title: Leap
level_ten.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: No Escape
level_thirteen.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.

level_sixteen.title: Nerves of Steel
level_sixteen.description: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.

level_twenty.title: Ignore Pain
level_twenty.description: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.

level_one.title: Nerubian Armor
level_one.description: Increase Harden Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

level_four.title: Underking
level_four.description: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

level_seven.title: Subterranean Shield
level_seven.description: Burrow Charge also grants a 400 (+4% per level) point Shield for 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Cocoon
level_ten.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

level_thirteen.title: Burning Beetles
level_thirteen.description: Deal 21 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

level_sixteen.title: Epicenter
level_sixteen.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

level_twenty.title: Rewind
level_twenty.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

level_one.title: Wave of Light
level_one.description: Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance.  Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds.  Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_four.title: Pursuit of Justice
level_four.description: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Hand of Protection
level_seven.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Divine Storm
level_ten.description: Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Well Met
level_thirteen.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Benediction
level_sixteen.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Divine Hurricane
level_twenty.description: Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.

level_one.title: Perfect Aim
level_one.description: Increases Gilnean Cocktail's range by 30% and refunds 45 Mana if it hits an enemy Hero.

level_four.title: Thick Skin
level_four.description: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

level_seven.title: Incendiary Elixir
level_seven.description: Quest: Reduce the cooldown of Gilnean Cocktail by 2 seconds. Every time Greymane hits an enemy Hero with the explosion damage from Gilnean Cocktail, increase its explosion damage by 25, up to 375.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, the cooldown is reduced by an additional 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Cursed Bullet
level_ten.description: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.  Does not affect Vehicles.

level_thirteen.title: Running Wild
level_thirteen.description: Increases Darkflight and Disengage's range by 35%, and reduce their cooldowns by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Lord of His Pack
level_sixteen.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Greymane's Basic Attack damage by 25% for 3 seconds, increased to 50% while in Worgen Form.

level_twenty.title: Gilnean Roulette
level_twenty.description: Cursed Bullet's damage is reduced to 30% of current health but its cooldown is reduced by 24 seconds.

level_one.title: On The Prowl
level_one.description: Activate to gain 25 Rage over 8 seconds.  Passive: You heal for 7 (+4% per level) Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

level_four.title: Hogger's Joggers
level_four.description: While above 35Rage, gain 10% increased Movement Speed and healing received.  When at or above 50 Rage, increase these bonuses to 15%.

level_seven.title: Garbage Fire
level_seven.description: Reduce the cooldown of Loot Hoard by 2 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in a large area around Loot Hoard take 23 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 20%.

level_ten.title: Hoardapult
level_ten.description: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.  Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

level_thirteen.title: Pummel
level_thirteen.description: Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.  Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 30% for 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Headbanger
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: No Control
level_twenty.description: Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.  Cannot be cancelled.

level_one.title: Frost Presence
level_one.description: Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%.  Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Howling Blast.  Reward: After Hitting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path.  Reward: After Hitting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 1.25 seconds.

level_four.title: Shattered Armor
level_four.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Immortal Coil
level_seven.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Army of the Dead
level_ten.description: Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.  Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Deathlord
level_thirteen.description: If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.  Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

level_sixteen.title: Anti-Magic Shell
level_sixteen.description: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

level_twenty.title: Legion of Northrend
level_twenty.description: Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.  Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

level_one.title: Scroll of Identify
level_one.description: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Scroll of Sealing permanently increases its damage by 2.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, this talent's Armor reduction effect is increased to 15 and its duration to 6 seconds.

level_four.title: Potion of Shielding
level_four.description: Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a 140 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

level_seven.title: Emerald
level_seven.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and have it reduce the healing received of enemy Heroes by 75% for 4 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

level_ten.title: Stay Awhile and Listen
level_ten.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.  Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

level_thirteen.title: Potion of Revival
level_thirteen.description: When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for 75% of the healing amount.

level_sixteen.title: Scroll of Stone Curse
level_sixteen.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

level_twenty.title: Bottomless Flask
level_twenty.description: After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.

level_one.title: Colossal Totem
level_one.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level_four.title: Earthliving Enchant
level_four.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Purification
level_seven.description: If Purge removes a Slow, Stun, Root, or Silence effect from an ally, heal them for 220 (+4% per level).  Using Purge on an enemy Hero deals up to 330 (+4% per level) damage to Shields and reduces healing received by 40% for 2 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Purge's cooldown by 15 seconds.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Earth Shield
level_thirteen.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Rising Storm
level_sixteen.description: Every time a Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.  Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Farseer's Blessing
level_twenty.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

level_one.title: Creed of the Hunter
level_one.description: Quest: Every 50 Basic Attacks against Heroes increases Hatred's damage bonus per stack by 1%, up to 6%.  Gambit: Gain 25% bonus Attack Speed. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

level_four.title: Death Dealer
level_four.description: Increase Vaults Basic Attack damage bonus from 6% to 15% per stack of Hatred. If this attack kills its victim within 1.5 seconds, the Mana cost and cooldown of Vault are refunded.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Vault by 5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Hot Pursuit
level_seven.description: Increase the Movement Speed bonus of each stack of Hatred from 1% to 2%.

level_ten.title: Rain of Vengeance
level_ten.description: Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Gloom
level_thirteen.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

level_sixteen.title: Manticore
level_sixteen.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_twenty.title: Farflight Quiver
level_twenty.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack range. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Basic Attack range.
